svg.text: Figure 1 | Deep learning for antimicrobial peptide (AMP) prediction. Numbered panels follow the workflow: AMP structural biology with the bacterial-lysis mechanism (amphipathic helices, carpet / toroidal-pore

membrane disruption), dual feature tracks (hand-crafted descriptors + protein-language-model embeddings), symmetric CNN / BiLSTM / Transformer columns fused into hybrids, ROC–AUC and MCC evaluation, and translation.
